At cycle 1500 at 1C, the cathode delivered 306 mAh/gS of sulfur. This is 100% of the capacity it delivered at cycle 1500, which is calculated as 306 mAh/gS. 

In the rate test, the cathode delivered 370 mAh/gS of sulfur at 1C, which is the reversible capacity. Therefore, the share of the capacity at cycle 1500 at 1C of the reversible capacity at 1C in the rate test is 306 mAh/gS / 370 mAh/gS = 0.827 or 82.7%.
